items_acquisition_value_check.name: items_acquisition_value_check
items_acquisition_value_check.value: "items"."acquisition_value_cents" IS NULL OR (typeof("items"."acquisition_value_cents")='integer' AND "items"."acquisition_value_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000)

projects_interval_check.name: projects_interval_check
projects_interval_check.value: "projects"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "projects"."ends_at" > "projects"."starts_at"

records_interval_check.name: records_interval_check
records_interval_check.value: "records"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "records"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "records"."ends_at" >= "records"."starts_at"

followup_checklist_damage_limit.name: followup_checklist_damage_limit
followup_checklist_damage_limit.value: ("followup_checklist_items"."counted" IS NULL AND "followup_checklist_items"."damaged"=0) OR ("followup_checklist_items"."counted" IS NOT NULL AND "followup_checklist_items"."damaged"<="followup_checklist_items"."counted")

followup_task_references.name: followup_task_references
followup_task_references.value: "followup_tasks"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("followup_tasks"."campaign_id" IS NULL AND "followup_tasks"."item_id" IS NULL AND "followup_tasks"."loan_id" IS NULL)

work_responsibility_person_idx.name: work_responsibility_person_idx
work_responsibility_person_idx.where: "work_responsibility_assignees"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "work_responsibility_assignees"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

work_responsibility_team_idx.name: work_responsibility_team_idx
work_responsibility_team_idx.where: "work_responsibility_assignees"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "work_responsibility_assignees"."team_id" IS NOT NULL

work_responsibility_target.name: work_responsibility_target
work_responsibility_target.value: ("work_responsibility_scopes"."area"='projects' AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."item_id" IS NULL AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."loan_id" IS NULL AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."campaign_id" IS NULL) OR ("work_responsibility_scopes"."area"='materials' AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."loan_id" IS NULL AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."campaign_id" IS NULL) OR ("work_responsibility_scopes"."area"='loans' AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."item_id" IS NULL AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."campaign_id" IS NULL) OR ("work_responsibility_scopes"."area"='campaigns' AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."item_id" IS NULL AND "work_responsibility_scopes"."loan_id" IS NULL)

portal_feedback_campaign_project.name: portal_feedback_campaign_project
portal_feedback_campaign_project.value: "portal_feedback"."campaign_id" IS NULL OR "portal_feedback"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

portal_feedback_response.name: portal_feedback_response
portal_feedback_response.value: ("portal_feedback"."response" IS NULL AND "portal_feedback"."responded_by" IS NULL AND "portal_feedback"."responded_at" IS NULL) OR (length("portal_feedback"."response") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND "portal_feedback"."responded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "portal_feedback"."responded_at" IS NOT NULL)

team_sheet_token_ttl.name: team_sheet_token_ttl
team_sheet_token_ttl.value: julianday("team_sheet_tokens"."expires_at") IS NOT NULL AND julianday("team_sheet_tokens"."created_at") IS NOT NULL AND julianday("team_sheet_tokens"."expires_at")>julianday("team_sheet_tokens"."created_at") AND julianday("team_sheet_tokens"."expires_at")-julianday("team_sheet_tokens"."created_at")<=30.00001

structure_root.name: structure_root
structure_root.value: ("institutional_nodes"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "institutional_nodes"."relation"='root') OR("institutional_nodes"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "institutional_nodes"."relation"!='root')

planning_session_date.name: planning_session_date
planning_session_date.value: length("campaign_sessions"."session_date")=10 AND date("campaign_sessions"."session_date") IS "campaign_sessions"."session_date" AND "campaign_sessions"."session_date" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2100-12-31'

planning_session_confirmed.name: planning_session_confirmed
planning_session_confirmed.value: "campaign_sessions"."status" NOT IN('confirmed','done') OR ("campaign_sessions"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_sessions"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL)

directory_source.name: directory_source
directory_source.value: ("directory_people"."source_kind"='manual' AND "directory_people"."reference_id" IS NULL AND "directory_people"."source_url" IS NULL AND "directory_people"."source_updated_on" IS NULL) OR ("directory_people"."source_kind"='official' AND "directory_people"."reference_id" IS NOT NULL AND "directory_people"."source_url" IS NOT NULL AND "directory_people"."source_url"='https://proex.ufg.br/p/equipe-proex' AND "directory_people"."source_updated_on" IS NOT NULL)

material_attention_resolved.name: material_attention_resolved
material_attention_resolved.value: ("material_attention_episodes"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "material_attention_episodes"."resolved_available" IS NULL AND "material_attention_episodes"."resolution" IS NULL) OR ("material_attention_episodes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "material_attention_episodes"."resolved_available" IS NOT NULL AND "material_attention_episodes"."resolution" IS NOT NULL)

chat_conversations_kind.name: chat_conversations_kind
chat_conversations_kind.value: ("chat_conversations"."kind"='project' AND "chat_conversations"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_conversations"."user_a" IS NULL AND "chat_conversations"."user_b" IS NULL) OR ("chat_conversations"."kind"='direct' AND "chat_conversations"."project_id" IS NULL AND "chat_conversations"."user_a" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_conversations"."user_b" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_conversations"."user_a"<"chat_conversations"."user_b")

ombuds_designations_revoke.name: ombuds_designations_revoke
ombuds_designations_revoke.value: ("ombuds_designations"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "ombuds_designations"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "ombuds_designations"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) OR ("ombuds_designations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ombuds_designations"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND length("ombuds_designations"."revoke_reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 300)

google_drive_connections_token.name: google_drive_connections_token
google_drive_connections_token.value: ("google_drive_connections"."status"='active' AND "google_drive_connections"."token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "google_drive_connections"."key_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("google_drive_connections"."status"='revoked' AND "google_drive_connections"."token_ciphertext" IS NULL)

google_drive_folders_text.name: google_drive_folders_text
google_drive_folders_text.value: length("google_drive_folders"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length("google_drive_folders"."purpose") BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND length("google_drive_folders"."drive_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

org_guide_pages_slug.name: org_guide_pages_slug
org_guide_pages_slug.value: length("org_guide_pages"."slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "org_guide_pages"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

org_risks_campaign.name: org_risks_campaign
org_risks_campaign.value: "org_risks"."campaign_id" IS NULL OR "org_risks"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

campaign_volunteers_revoke_check.name: campaign_volunteers_revoke_check
campaign_volunteers_revoke_check.value: ("campaign_volunteers"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "campaign_volunteers"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "campaign_volunteers"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) OR ("campaign_volunteers"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_volunteers"."revoke_reason" IN ('expired','revoked'))
